profile.headline: Software Engineer at Providence Health & Services
profile.summary:
Working in Javascript and Ruby on Rails. I really love the problem solving aspect coding. Taking an idea and creating it in real life with code is very exciting to me. 

Having a background in design has given me the tools to better organize and structure my code. Studying user experience design has given me empathy and a better understanding of how a user might approach one of my applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Creating and managing a LIMS application in Ruby.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
- Create Rails dashboard app for monitoring all applications used in genomic sequencing.
- Implement Graphviz and D3 to create graphs of all applications in the Rails app.
- Create yaml file and code to seed database in Rails app.
- Modify CSS layout for PDF rendering application.

projects.title: Chord Progression Generator
projects.description: An app created with Javascript and jQuery. You can choose the key and scale and generate a chord progression. Then you can click between musical genres to see different chord progressions for a specific genre.

projects.title: Pizza Restaurant Site
projects.description: A pizza ordering site in Javascript and jQuery. You can choose the size and amount of toppings for your pizza. Your order and total will display at the bottom of the page.
